exq.q: How many brothers and sisters does Leo have?
exq.why: “one older sister and a little brother” = một chị gái và một em trai, tổng hai người.

exq.q: Who does Leo's sister take after?
exq.why: “She takes after our mom.” = chị ấy giống mẹ.

exq.q: What does Leo's sister want to be?
exq.why: “wants to be a vet” = muốn làm bác sĩ thú y.

exq.q: Which sentence about Leo's parents is true?
exq.a: His dad is strict and his mom is easygoing
w: His mom is strict and his dad is easygoing
exq.why: “My dad is, but my mom is easygoing.” = bố nghiêm khắc, mẹ dễ tính.
